feedback.issue: check() discards the exit code and returns "none" whenever no [CACHE] line appears; the AILANG_NO_CACHE subtest therefore passes if the binary crashes, times out, or --debug-compile output changes

feedback.issue: size+mtime collides on coarse-mtime filesystems (HFS+ 1s, FAT/exFAT 2s, some network/overlay mounts) when two rebuilds land in the same tick with the same size; Mach-O segment alignment makes equal sizes common after small edits. ns-precision APFS/ext4 makes it practically unreachable. Also cp -p/rsync -a of a different same-size binary
feedback.suggestion: add inode and ctime (ctime cannot be preserved by cp -p/touch) to the fingerprint; still microseconds
